items.title: Romeo Doubs: Unlikely to return Sunday
items.text:
Head coach Mike Vrabel said Friday that Doubs (shoulder) likely won't play in Sunday's game against the Chargers, Evan Lazar of the Patriots' official site reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: A.J. Brown: Ruled out for Sunday's game
items.text:
Brown (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chargers, Doug Kyed of the Boston Herald reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Tetairoa McMillan: In uniform for Friday's practice
items.text:
McMillan (foot) was wearing a helmet and pads ahead of Friday's practice, Mike Kaye of ESPN.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jeremiyah Love: No updated on status for Week 13
items.text:
Head coach Mike LaFleur said Friday that he has no update on Love (ankle), who is eligible to come off injured reserve following Sunday's game against the Commanders, Bo Brack of GoPHNX.com reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Colston Loveland: Week-to-week with second opinion pending
items.text:
Loveland (knee) is slated to get a second opinion on his knee injury and won't be placed on injured reserve for now, though he is considered week-to-week, Adam Schefter of ESPN reports.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
